description: This file defines a Smarty plugin for the 'lower' modifier, which converts a string to lowercase using either mb_strtolower for multibyte string support or strtolower as a fallback.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_lower
methods.description: Generates code to convert a string to lowercase, choosing between mb_strtolower and strtolower based on multibyte string support.
